title: Government hikes windfall tax on diesel, ATF; cuts levy on petrol exports
description: The rate of Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) on diesel exports has been increased to ₹15.5 a litre from ₹8.5 a litre; similarly, SAED on ATF exports has been raised to ₹14.5 per litre from ₹7.5 per litre till July 15
